eyebrow: The cutover sequence, written down in advance
code:
1. Final validation: row counts + checksums reconcile
2. Freeze on-prem writes (planned maintenance window)
3. One last incremental sync pass
4. Re-validate row counts match exactly
5. Point the claims app at Azure, lift maintenance mode
6. Soak period before decommissioning on-prem
caption: If step 4 fails, on-prem stays the system of record. The rollback path is never theoretical.
